name: 動物取扱業 per-animal ledger and annual report (April-May) tool
buyer: Pet shops, breeders, rental/exhibit/boarding-type 登録業者 (headcount unverified)
trigger: 動物愛護管理法 as amended (in force 2020-06-01): ledger per dog/cat, 5-year retention, 定期報告 from 1 April to 30 May to the prefecture
existing: Two Japanese searches found only prefectural paper/Excel templates; no software product seen (pet-shop POS and breeder tools may exist, unchecked).
unchecked: Number of registered operators; existing pet-shop POS/breeder software; whether マイクロチップ registration duties (breeders/sellers) add recurring workload; WTP; prefecture-by-prefecture form variation.

first_check.duty: Animal Welfare Act (動物愛護管理法) as amended, in force since 2020-06-01. Businesses registered for sale, rental, exhibition or 譲受飼養 (動物販売業者等) must: (a) keep a ledger for 5 years, per animal for dogs and cats and per breed for other mammals, birds and reptiles. It records breed, breeder, birth date, acquisition, sale or handover, the face-to-face explanation given to buyers, death date and cause, and so on. Electronic records are allowed. (b) File an annual 定期報告 from 1 April to 30 May covering the previous fiscal year: animals held at the start, new animals each month, sales and deaths each month, and animals held at year end. It is filed with the registering prefecture or designated city by e-filing (LoGo form in Tokyo and Saitama), post or counter. Since 2022-06-01, dog and cat sellers must also microchip each animal and register it on the national Ministry of the Environment (環境省) site within 30 days or before handover, whichever comes first. The fees reported are ¥400 online and ¥1,400 on paper; this comes from a prefectural page I did not open. The penalty amount was not checked (not_reached). Registration can be refused or cancelled for violations under the Act's general enforcement rules, also not verified in this session.
first_check.market: I did not get a national total. The Ministry of the Environment 行政事務提要 summary table PDF (r02 2_1_1) could not be parsed. Regional figures: Kanagawa has 1,504 registered type-1 facilities as of 2026-03-31; Okayama had 425 in FY2025, about half of them sales businesses. Scaling up by population suggests tens of thousands of facilities nationwide, but this is not verified. Only the sale, rental, exhibition and 譲受飼養 categories carry the ledger and report duty; boarding and training do not.
first_check.competitor: No Japanese software found that produces the 帳簿 or the 定期報告 form. Seen: foreign breeder software (BreederHQ, Breeder Cloud Pro, Cattery Manager, Husbandry.Pro) with no Japanese report format; general pet-shop POS and system write-ups (aurant-technologies) and a kintone do-it-yourself guide for pet shops. Prefectures provide free Excel ledger and report templates (Saitama, Ibaraki, Tokyo, Sakai, Kyoto), and Tokyo and Saitama accept LoGo form e-filing. Microchip registration goes through the free national 環境省 portal. Not checked: ledger features inside large chain POS systems (for example in-house systems at big pet-shop chains).
first_check.reason: Confirmed: the duty is real and in force, and no Japanese product doing this job was found. Since the 2020-06-01 amendment to 動物愛護管理法, 動物販売業者等 (sale, rental, exhibition and 譲受飼養) must keep ledgers for 5 years (per animal for dogs and cats, per breed for other animals; electronic records allowed). They must file a 定期報告 with monthly counts of animals held, sold and dead between 1 April and 30 May. Six Japanese and English searches turned up only foreign breeder apps (BreederHQ, Breeder Cloud Pro, Cattery Manager), general pet-shop POS and kintone build-it-yourself guides, plus free prefectural Excel templates. Tokyo and Saitama accept LoGo e-filing. The weak points: the report is once a year and is simple counting from a free template, small breeders are unlikely to pay much, and the microchip registration site is a separate state portal.

challenge_check.killer: None found. Partial substitutes: free prefectural Excel templates for the ledger and report (Tokyo, Saitama, Kyoto), and email or LoGo e-filing in Tokyo and Saitama.
challenge_check.reason: Eight Japanese searches found no Japanese product that produces the per-dog/cat 帳簿 or the April-May 定期報告. The only hits were foreign breeder apps (BreederHQ, Breeder Cloud Pro, Husbandry.Pro) with no Japanese format, plus a vendor article (jisaku.com) saying shops still use paper or Excel. No exemption or repeal surfaced; the duty has applied since 2020-06. What limits it: prefectures hand out free Excel templates, and Tokyo and Saitama take email or LoGo e-filing. The report itself is only monthly head counts by species, done once a year. Big chains probably run their own systems. Many breeders are price-sensitive home businesses. The national registration count was not verified; an industry survey estimated about 11,700 dog-breeding facilities.
